name: Whisper.cpp CPU local speech route
scope: Pinned source build and strict output admission; no installer, model discovery or implicit acquisition.

source.license: MIT; preserve complete original source, bundled miniaudio licensing and model notices.

prerequisites: Existing native C/C++ compiler and make
Admitted CMake3.31.10 toolchain on the observed Mac; other hosts require their own native admission
build.network_acquisition: None during configure/build; optional fetch/backend switches disabled.
build.identity_limit: A new source build on another host must retain its own flags/output hashes; byte-reproducibility is not claimed.

model.name: ggml-base.en.bin
model.acquisition: Existing verified model reused; this recipe never downloads a model.

invocation.input_contract: Explicit stable regular CLI/model/source files under one owner. Mono16-bitPCM WAV at16kHz; stream and validate the complete bounded declared PCM payload, reject truncation/partialframes before execution. No concurrent-writer isolation claim.
invocation.output_contract: New absent run directory only; no overwrites/retries. Require producerexit0 plus matching fresh JSON/SRT/TXT with ordered source-bounded millisecond timings. Blank JSON/SRT cues must also match, in order; unmatched/backward empty SRT cues fail. Retain failed stdout/stderr/partials/RUN.json.
invocation.empty_transcript: Explicit empty_transcript status; use --expect-speech when an empty result must fail. It is not proof that the source contained no speech.
invocation.effects: CPU transcription only, no microphone/camera capture, account/config discovery, provider calls or implicit model acquisition.
invocation.concurrency_limit: Regular stable-input precondition; pre/post hashes are not isolation against concurrent mutation/restoration.

negative_controls: Extra forward/backward blankSRT cues rejected; matchingJSON/SRTblankcue accepted

limits: One public English fixture, approximate word timing; not forced alignment, diarization, arbitrary language/noise quality or general semantic highlight acceptance.
